entities.name: Nitro substrate
observations: Contains an aromatic nitro group on a pyridine ring, plus a methanesulfonamide and tertiary piperazine.

entities.name: Aminopyridine product
observations: The nitro group is replaced by an exocyclic amino group; other major functional groups are retained.

entities.name: Aromatic nitro reduction
observations: Net transformation: Ar-NO2 to Ar-NH2 on a nitropyridine substrate.
The molecular formula change is consistent with loss of two oxygens and addition of two hydrogens.
Likely reagent families include catalytic hydrogenation, metal/ammonium salt reductions, and tin(II) chloride reduction.
